text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond was able to deliver a truly 
satisfying performance in her debut race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When she returned to the waiting room, she 
openly expressed her joy at having 
debuted, showing a rare sense of 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, rumors can be heard that 
"there is a jinx that Satono Umamusume can 
never win a G1."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Satono Diamond boldly declared 
that she would be the one to shatter the 
jinx.
